CustomField.description:
A temporary field to be used for data analysis following the recalculation of quotes for ARR purposes on March 3, 2023.
This field can be deleted after 14 days (March 17, 2023)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The value in this field is the Net Amount of the quote prior running the ARR recalculation on March 3, 2023
CustomField.label: Net Amount prior to March 3 ARR recalc
